label_field_description: Choose by the project's operational meaning, not generic database update semantics. RETAIN: new evidence positively confirms the old claim still applies in its context. UPDATE: two distinct real-world stages of the same concrete process; requires actual progression beyond the old stage, never just later narration, added attributes, a name or a more specific description of an already completed event. SUPERSEDE: explicit replacement of factual states in the same dimension. CONFLICT: incompatible claims under the same applicability that evidence cannot resolve. undetermined: evidence insufficient for an allowed relation. RETAIN, SUPERSEDE and CONFLICT require identical state_key; UPDATE may cross keys.
